resolved_cores.evidence: config best_single.implementation = confirmatory_v4_selection.select_best_single; best_single_legal demoted to SIMULATION_ONLY_REFERENCE ('NOT production'). Selector allowlist-projects to {split, session_id, trial_role, theta.grasp_offset_local_y, y.success, planned_episode_id}; no tau/succ/nominal/residual/actual/eff/oracle. Functionally verified: perturbing secret fields does not change selection; flipping observed y.success does. Algorithm = max observed-success count -> min|offset| -> bank order (787/787 vs frozen rule; not hardcoded 0). Rejects test/probe/non-bool. Artifact saves counts/means/tie-sets/selected + projection/record-set/artifact hashes.

confirmatory_v4_identity freezes block/session/trial templates (v4|split=..|block=NN|nominal=+.3f|role=..|offset=+.3f), +0.000 zero with negative-zero normalized, block 2-digit zero-based, role distinguishes probe/candidate at -0.04. planned_episode_id = v4ep-<sha256[:24]>; 300 planned trials, 300 unique ids (recomputed). Domain subseeds via PRE.subseed (sha256, not Python hash()); frozen domain labels; attempt_id/resume_key exclude attempt from randomization.

facets: 3.3: _check_completeness verifies TOTAL 57 sessions and 3-per-session, but NOT the 45 train / 12 validation composition. A malformed split (e.g. 57 train + 0 val) passes, and could change best-single (the baseline is the pooled train+val mean). Config input_completeness.checks lists '57 unique sessions', not 45/12.

3.4: select_best_single (the config-designated production entry) exposes validate_completeness=False, candidate_bank=..., expected_candidate_records=... The active config freezes NONE of these (0 occurrences), and there is no non-default -> INVALID guard. A can therefore disable the completeness gate or swap the bank on the production path -> per task 3.4 this alone withholds GO.
new_blockers.minimal_fix: (a) In _check_completeness, assert exactly 45 train + 12 validation sessions (count per split), in addition to total 57. (b) Expose a public production wrapper select_best_single_confirmatory(records) that hardcodes validate_completeness=True, expected_candidate_records=171, candidate_bank=(-0.04,0,+0.04) and does NOT accept overrides, OR freeze these in the active config and make any non-default production call raise EXPERIMENT_INVALID_BEST_SINGLE_INPUT. Keep validate_completeness=False reachable only inside the sim bridge, not on the production entry.

new_blockers.summary: trial_identity/block_identity/session_identity validate only split and role; they format arbitrary out-of-domain inputs. Verified accepted: block=99, nominal=0.5 (not in split), probe offset=+0.02 (must be -0.04), block=-1 (also breaks 2-digit padding), offset=0.07 (not in bank). This leaves A manifest freedom despite enumerate_trials() being domain-correct.
new_blockers.minimal_fix: Validate the frozen domain in the identity builders (or a wrapper the generator must use): block in BLOCKS[split], nominal in NOMINALS[split], probe offset == -0.04, candidate offset in CANDIDATE_BANK, block>=0, attempt in [0,1]. Reject otherwise. Add a test that out-of-domain identities raise.

new_blockers.summary: canonical_manifest_hash() hashes only [canonical_trial_identity, planned_episode_id] (planned STRUCTURE). But confirmatory_v4_manifest_spec.md calls manifest_hash 'sha256 of the fully-resolved manifest (pre-run)' and 'Reproducible via confirmatory_v4_identity.canonical_manifest_hash()', and the per-trial integrity check is 'science_manifest_sha256 == frozen manifest_hash'. A structure-only anchor does NOT cover the resolved residual, nuisance, execution order, or environment, so residual/nuisance/order tampering would pass the integrity check.
new_blockers.minimal_fix: Rename canonical_manifest_hash() -> canonical_planned_structure_hash() and define a SEPARATE full manifest_hash over the fully-resolved plan (planned structure + per-block residual values + nuisance + resolved block/session/nominal/candidate orders + seeds + config_hash + code/generator commit + environment), with a frozen canonical serialization; use THAT as the per-trial science_manifest_sha256 integrity anchor. Correct the manifest_spec wording. This affects seal/integrity, hence blocker not minor.
